project_info.theme: Emotional reminder not to interrupt a long phone relationship by forgetting verification
project_info.color_palette: Warm amber, cozy brown wood, soft cream, white, Viettel red, blush pink

main_subject.detail: A large smartphone laid horizontally like a miniature memory room, filled with hanging string lights, pinned polaroid photos, calendars, envelopes, and a cute anthropomorphic SIM-card mascot holding a pink heart. Large hand-drawn style text on the right says 'Cảm ơn bạn đã cùng tôi: ❤️', followed by check marks with 'Hơn 20 năm', 'Hàng nghìn cuộc gọi', 'Hàng triệu tin nhắn'. A cloud speech bubble at the bottom right says 'Nhiều năm bên nhau Đừng để gián đoạn vì quên xác thực bạn nhé! ❤️'.
main_subject.style: Whimsical 3D diorama advertising art, cozy handcrafted memory-box aesthetic, sentimental telecom storytelling

composition_elements.text: viettel telecom; Cảm ơn bạn đã cùng tôi: ❤️; Hơn 20 năm; Hàng nghìn cuộc gọi; Hàng triệu tin nhắn; Nhiều năm bên nhau Đừng để gián đoạn vì quên xác thực bạn nhé! ❤️
items: Top Left: Viettel telecom logo in white
Top Right: White and red handwritten banner text with small doodle heart and call/message icons floating nearby
Bottom Left: Wooden tabletop with notebook, pen, coffee mug, and the corner of the horizontal smartphone
Bottom Right: Large white cloud speech bubble outlined in black
Center/Background: Cozy warm wood interior backdrop, giant horizontal smartphone turned into a glowing scrapbook room with photos and a smiling SIM mascot holding a heart

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Soft amber glow, shallow depth of field, bokeh string lights, handcrafted diorama warmth

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square advertising poster for an emotional telecom reminder not to interrupt a long phone relationship by forgetting verification. Centerpiece is a giant horizontal smartphone transformed into a warm miniature memory room with string lights, polaroid photos, calendars, envelopes, and a cute anthropomorphic SIM-card mascot holding a pink heart. Include the exact visible text 'Cảm ơn bạn đã cùng tôi: ❤️', 'Hơn 20 năm', 'Hàng nghìn cuộc gọi', 'Hàng triệu tin nhắn', and 'Nhiều năm bên nhau Đừng để gián đoạn vì quên xác thực bạn nhé! ❤️'. Background is a warm wood-and-window setting with dreamy blur. Surrounding elements: Viettel telecom logo at top left, doodled heart and call/message icons on the right, tabletop stationery and coffee in the foreground, and a white cloud speech bubble at the bottom right. Technical style: high-end 3D diorama advertising illustration, warm cozy fairy-light illumination, amber glow and shallow-depth bokeh, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: This image depends on the warm handmade diorama mood. The phone must behave like a miniature room, not a normal device screen. Keep the emotional copy exact and the SIM mascot charming rather than corporate.
